description: Blocks a SUBAGENT (agent_id present) from calling the Monitor tool AT ALL. Monitor is CC's fire-and-forget background watch (start it, keep working, get notified per output line/event LATER) — there is no foreground mode. A subagent is NOT re-invoked by that later notification (only the main loop is, agent-tools#52's sibling wedge, hit via Monitor instead of a backgrounded Bash command in HYP-1350's retrospective), so calling Monitor and ending the turn wedges the worker forever with uncommitted work and no PR. Unconditional: unlike subagent-no-bg-longproc there is no backgrounded-vs-foreground classification to make, because Monitor IS the background primitive by construction — every subagent call to it is the wedge, regardless of what it watches. The orchestrator's own Monitor use (e.g. watching a backgrounded subagent) is unaffected — this gate governs only tool calls made inside a dispatched subagent. The suggested remedy is two-shaped: (1) a single long-running command the subagent just started — set `run_in_background: true` on the Bash tool call, the harness auto-resumes the subagent when it completes; (2) anything else — a bounded FOREGROUND heartbeat loop the subagent blocks on inline (`timeout 540 bash -c 'i=0; until <check> || [ "$i" -ge 26 ]; do sleep 20; i=$((i+1)); echo "[wait] tick $i"; done'`, echoing at least every ~20s and staying under the Bash tool's own 600s cap), which itself passes subagent-no-bg-longproc's own rules (verified: not a `sleep N>=10` invocation at argv[0], not backgrounded). Deny-by-default: no self-service bypass; a would-be BLOCK consults RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_SUBAGENT_NO_MONITOR with a written justification, which asks Telegram via trusted tg-ctl and allows ONLY on an approval tap (a blank/bare 1 denies). timeout_ms 960000 covers tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus margin so a hung ask can't race the dispatcher's timeout kill into a silent on_error=open ALLOW; a CC settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must set timeout >960s. on_error=open. Registration note: firing requires a rig-cli `Monitor` PreToolUse matcher (see lib/cc_hook_bridge/README.md's Extensibility section) — the point mapping alone is inert until that matcher ships / rig apply runs.
